gates.name: Scope Gate
gates.input: Task description, proposed changes, scope definition
automated_checks: No new authority creation without proper process
human_checks: Design Director confirms scope alignment with SOUL
pass_criteria: Scope is clearly defined and aligned with SOUL principles
No attempts to create new authorities without governance process
All changes use existing token/system authorities
Scope document approved by Design Director
fail_criteria: Scope contradicts SOUL principles
Attempt to bypass Token/TypographyTokens system
Scope creep detected without proper change classification
New authority created without following promotion path
gates.artifact: Scope approval document with SOUL alignment verification

gates.name: Design Gate
automated_checks: Design Review checklist (13 items) auto-validation where possible
human_checks: Design Director approval for L1/L2 changes (identity, specifications)
Relevant L1 Governor approval for specification changes
Component Governor approval for new components/variants
pass_criteria: Design Review checklist passes with >=80% auto-validated items
All designs use existing tokens and components where applicable
New components follow official taxonomy
Accessibility considerations documented
fail_criteria: Design Review checklist fails critical items
Designs introduce arbitrary tokens or hardcoded values
New components violate taxonomy without justification
Accessibility violations identified
gates.artifact: Design approval document with checklist results and governor sign-offs

gates.name: Implementation Gate
automated_checks: flutter analyze (0 errors on modified files)
No hardcoded values scan (colors, spacing, typography)
human_checks: Component Governor review for component usage
Design Director review for UI/UX fidelity
pass_criteria: flutter analyze shows 0 new errors on modified files
No hardcoded brand colors, spacing, or typography values
All components use tokens from appropriate authorities
All icons use GlowIcon system
Token.of(context) used for all color/typography access
fail_criteria: flutter analyze introduces new errors
Hardcoded values detected in modified files
Components bypass token system
Material/Cupertino icons used when GlowIcon equivalent exists
Direct Theme.of(context) usage for color/typography
gates.artifact: Implementation approval document with analyze results and code review sign-offs

gates.name: Validation Gate
human_checks: Quality Governor validation of test results
Lead Engineer confirmation of build success
pass_criteria: All unit and widget tests pass
Release build succeeds without errors
Accessibility audit shows no WCAG AA violations
Performance benchmarks meet specified budgets
API contracts validated against specification
fail_criteria: Any unit or widget test fails
Release build fails or produces errors
Accessibility audit shows WCAG AA violations
Performance benchmarks exceed specified budgets
API contract violations detected
gates.artifact: Validation approval document with test results, build logs, and accessibility report

gates.name: Visual QA Gate
human_checks: Quality Governor confirmation of automated checks
pass_criteria: No visual regressions against approved specifications
Perfect parity between Women/Men/AURA expressions
All components display correctly in component gallery
Responsive layouts work at all breakpoints (0/600/1024/1440)
fail_criteria: Visual regressions detected against specifications
Expression parity violations (Women/Men/AURA differences)
Component display issues in gallery
Responsive layout failures at any breakpoint
gates.artifact: Visual QA approval document with screenshots, parity reports, and responsive test results

gates.name: Approval Gate
pass_criteria: All previous gates (G0-G4) show PASS status
Version bump decision follows semantic versioning rules
Release notes document all changes and validation results
Design Director provides recorded sign-off
fail_criteria: Any previous gate shows FAIL_BLOCKING status
Version bump decision violates semantic versioning
Release notes incomplete or missing validation results
Design Director sign-off missing or not recorded
gates.artifact: Approval record with Design Director sign-off and version decision

gates.name: Documentation Gate
gates.input: Approval records, changed specifications, implementation details
human_checks: Design Director confirmation of documentation adequacy
Technical Writer validation of technical accuracy
pass_criteria: All required documentation fields present and complete
Governance registries updated with changes
Migration documentation complete if legacy systems affected
Decision log entry created with all required fields
fail_criteria: Required documentation fields missing or incomplete
Governance registries not updated with changes
Migration documentation missing when legacy systems affected
Decision log entry missing required fields
gates.artifact: Complete documentation package with decision log and registry updates
